test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the number of students in Class A to Class B is 4 : 5. If 8 students are transferred from B to A, the ratio becomes 5:6. Find the original number of students in each class.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total students remain constant: Sum of initial ratio (4+5=9) and final ratio (5+6=11).

Equalize sum: Initial (44 : 55) and Final (45 : 54) by multiplying 9 with 11 and 11 with 9.

Increase in Class A = 45 − 44 = 1 unit → 8 students.

Class A = 44 × 8 = 352 | Class B = 55 × 8 = 440.

**∴ The correct answer is A- 352, B- 440.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Ratio A : B = 4 : 5

Let the students in A be 4x and B be 5x.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f016d0dd059baa68c93802e25aea31b1f7379c0a54512d24f1b5528b765413db.png] 

New ratio after transfer: (4x + 8) / (5x − 8) = 5 / 6

⇒ 6 × (4x + 8) = 5 × (5x − 8)

⇒ 24x + 48 = 25x − 40

⇒ 25x − 24x = 48 + 40

⇒ x = 88

⇒ Number of students in Class A = 4 × 88 = 352

⇒ Number of students in Class B = 5 × 88 = 440

**∴ The correct answer is A- 352, B- 440.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

Duplicate and Sub-duplicate Ratio

Duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b², while sub-duplicate ratio is √a : √b.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a/b = c/d, then (a + b)/(a − b) = (c + d)/(c − d).
